# Lattice fonts

Doto and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next are distributed under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1. The original OFL notices are included beside each font.

Sources (Google Fonts):
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/doto
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/atkinsonhyperlegiblenext

These are the upstream Lattice Latin faces, packaged locally for Electron's
offline/CSP environment. Chinese continues through the upstream system fallback.
